title: Independent electronic-structure investigation of E/Z-H2bte
difficulty_reasons: The paired structures are fixed, while the agent must formulate and discriminate plausible explanations for descriptor differences and justify validation coverage.

paper.title: Synthesis and structural characterization of the Z-isomer of 1,2-bis(tetrazol-5-yl)ethylene (H2bte) via photoinduced isomerization

data.description: Self-contained XYZ starting geometries and manifest for neutral singlet E- and Z-H2bte.

required_deliverables.description: Independent validated calculations, explanation tests, ESP extrema, NCI/LOL-p observations, limitations, and conclusion.
